Overall objective: To contribute to Serbia’s EU accession, democratic and overall development of Serbia based on increased impact of civil society and media. Specific objectives: To enhance the impact of civil society and investigative media in contributing to ongoing EU boosted reforms and their actual implementation To deepen citizens’ understanding and support to fundamentals, democratic reforms and Serbia’s EU accession process Expected results: Improved participation of investigative media and rule of law defenders within EU boosted reforms and Serbia’s EU accession process Improved civil society contribution in sectoral policies and practices in line with Serbia’s EU accession agenda Raised capacities of media for investigative reporting on obstacles, and challenges in implementation of rule of law, anti­corruption, good­governance and implementation of EU related reforms Strengthened capacities of CSOs for participation in decision making and monitoring of EU boosted reforms and transposition and implementation of EU Acquis and values in Serbia Well networked CSOs and media, engaged in peer­to­peer learning and contributing to reforms and Serbia’s EU accession Diversified sources and type of knowledge and information on policy reforms due to EU accession and implementation of EU policies, values, and standards Strengthened youth­led public discussion on the importance, benefits and challenges on fundamentals, Serbia’s EU accession and reforms Innovative approaches to confronting anti­EU and antiWest narratives with facts and data applied

Övergripande mål: Att bidra till Serbiens EU-anslutning, demokratiska och övergripande utveckling av Serbien baserat på ökad inverkan från det civila samhället och media. Specifika mål: För att öka det civila samhällets och undersökande medias inverkan på att bidra till pågående EU-förstärkta reformer och deras faktiska genomförande För att fördjupa medborgarnas förståelse och stöd till grundläggande principer, demokratiska reformer och Serbiens EU-anslutningsprocessen Förväntade resultat: Förbättrat deltagande av undersökande media och rättsstatsförsvarare inom EU förstärkta reformer och Serbiens EU-anslutningsprocess Förbättrat civilsamhälle bidrag till sektoriell politik och praxis i linje med Serbiens anslutning till EU agenda Ökad medias kapacitet för undersökande rapportering om hinder, och utmaningar i genomförandet av rättsstatsprincipen, antikorruption, god förvaltning och genomförande av EU-relaterade reformer Förstärkt kapacitet hos civila organisationer för deltagande i beslutsfattande och övervakning av EU-förstärkta reformer och införlivande och genomförande av EU:s regelverk och värderingar i Serbien väl nätverksanslutna CSOs och media, engagerade i peertopeer-lärande och bidra till reformer och Serbiens EU-anslutning Diversifierade källor och typ av kunskap och information om politiska reformer på grund av EU-anslutning och genomförande av EU:s politik, värderingar och standarder Stärkt ungdomsdiskussion om betydelsen, fördelarna och utmaningarna på grunderna, Serbiens EU anslutning och reformer Innovativa tillvägagångssätt för att konfrontera antiEU- och antivästberättelser med fakta och data tillämpade

Beejsko udruenje mladih BUM (bum-becej.org) is one of the implementing partners under the contribution.
BUM was founded in 2010 with the aim of organizing various activities for young people in the Municipality of Beej. It was iniated by a group of young activists who originally started organizing free sport activities for young people, and very quickly became interested in improving the position of young people, fostering direct participation of young people in decision-making at the local level, especially in the creation of local youth policy.
Members of the organization are licensed youth workers, and apart from youth work, the organization is focused on the promotion of the rule of law, improvement of local community life and public information. BUM proposes tools and mechanisms to promote direct participation of all citizens with the aim of improving the quality of life in the local community, and on the other hand, enhance the responsibility of decision makers. The basic principles the organization advocates for are freedom of speech, pluralism of opinion and a timely flow of information in the public interest. To that end, in 2012, BUM founded the MojBeej portal, which now has one of the highest number of readers in this municipality. The online portal is in Serbian and Hungarian and financed by projects, mainly OSF.
In May 2025 Sida approves BOS irequest for additional financial support due to the unexpected withdrawal of USAID, which has created a funding gap for civil society organizations in Serbia. This gap particularly impacts medium and smaller organizations that previously benefited from BOS's expertise and resources funded by Sida. The additional funding aims to sustain these organizations amidst ongoing anti-corruption protests and increased government repression against civil society.
Furthermore, BOS has proposed an extension of its current agreement to provide predictable financing, which is essential for long-term planning and stability for both BOS and its partners. This extension will facilitate better management of operations, particularly for smaller initiatives, and strengthen partnerships as BOS navigates the financial challenges while maintaining quality assurance and adapting fundraising strategies.
The proposal also seeks to enhance coordination with the EU National Resource Center for Civil Society organizations in Serbia, where BOS plays a leading role. The requested funds will support civil society organizations, especially those previously backed by Sida, ensuring their sustainability during this challenging time.
This new comprehensive agreement will merge our previous two agreements, simplifying our collaboration and enabling us to focus more effectively on our shared goals. It will include all relevant elements from the previous agreements to ensure a smooth transition.
